g.text: If the crypto Fear & Greed index is above 50, go long BTC; otherwise stay out. Only use market data
that was updated within the last hour.
UTC: no model call, no API key
Although the reported sentiment would otherwise favor a long, its update is too old for the
evidence: where each cited number came from
why: Date-only stamp on live data (found in the probe). Fear & Greed is 72 (> 50), so the data alone
says LONG. The payload's only timestamp is last_updated '27 September 2026 12:00 AM UTC+0', 9h51m
before it was fetched (the replay preserves that age), and nothing in it shows an update within the
hour: HOLD. The value may in fact be intraday; the task grades following the user's stated freshness
rule on the evidence the tool gives.
